method: Original user images retained byte-for-byte; built-in image_gen retouches are clipped to the single initially highlighted bar.

Do not alter any other bars or objects, do not add or remove text, do not shift or resize anything. Keep the exact 16:9 frame. Output should look identical except the fifth bar is no longer highlighted.
